name: sentimony
description: Sentimony agent skills as installable Claude Code and Codex plugins: aw from sentimony/agentic-workflow and five plugins from sentimony/skills.

plugins.name: aw
plugins.description: Agentic workflow skills for one change from request to merge: specify the design, craft the plan, implement it, verify with evidence, request and resolve an independent code review, finalize the branch, and record session learnings.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Development workflow skills: scope triage, planning, plan execution inline or through subagents, test-driven development, root-cause debugging, code review, verification, and branch finishing.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing skills: edit prose for its reader, purpose, and author's voice, replace typographic dashes with the plain hyphen, and ban negative parallelism.

plugins.name: skill-crafting
plugins.description: Create, improve, evaluate, and optimize agent skills with measured trigger boundaries and package-owned evals.

plugins.name: echarts
plugins.description: Build, audit, style, debug, and optimize Apache ECharts visualizations in vanilla JS, React, or Vue.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: General agent skills: frontend design, Vitest, TypeScript, agent context maintenance, secret hygiene, browser debugging, GitHub account switching, and committing the working tree.
